title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
blurb: Pre-trains a bidirectional Transformer encoder by predicting masked tokens and sentence order, then fine-tunes the same network for each downstream task.
intro: BERT is an encoder-only Transformer. Its novelty is the pre-training setup: WordPiece inputs packed as `[CLS] A [SEP] B [SEP]` with segment embeddings, a masked-language-model objective that lets every position use both left and right context, and a next-sentence classifier on `[CLS]`. The steps build the input pipeline and the corruption scheme, then the encoder and two fine-tuning heads; the capstone computes both pre-training losses from one forward pass.
